results.title: Sign-in screen and demonstration accounts
results.expected: The sign-in screen renders with three demo accounts
results.requirement: Definition of done: three demonstration accounts printed on the sign-in page
results.observation: Three demonstration accounts and the sign-in form rendered on first load.

results.title: Faculty sign-in
results.expected: The faculty shell opens on My reservations
results.observation: Faculty sign-in reached the shell; sidebar shows five faculty screens.

results.title: Student sign-in
results.expected: The student lands on their own section's schedule
results.observation: Student sign-in landed on their own section's schedule.

results.title: Administrator sign-in
results.expected: The dashboard opens with register KPIs
results.observation: Administrative sign-in landed on the dashboard with the register KPIs.

results.title: Wrong password refused
results.expected: Refused, shell never reached
results.requirement: Policy layer refuses before any screen renders
results.observation: A wrong password is refused and the shell is never reached.

results.title: Role switch swaps the demo account
results.expected: The login field shows the student account
results.requirement: Definition of done: three accounts on the sign-in page
results.observation: Switching role from faculty to student replaced the demonstration login.

results.title: Availability search across both buildings
results.expected: Free rooms and excluded count
results.requirement: Table 25 · room availability across both buildings
results.observation: Search returned free rooms, an excluded count and the window summary.

results.title: Every excluded room carries a reason
results.expected: Reasons are named per room
results.requirement: Listing 1 · the union of three occupancy sources
results.observation: The exclusion panel names the reason for each room that was withheld.

results.title: Book a room from the availability list
results.expected: Reservation confirmed with its id
results.requirement: Table 25 · faculty booking for four purposes
results.observation: A reservation was created from the availability list; the interface reported 'Request recorded for approval'.

results.title: Examination larger than any spaced room
results.expected: A split across two rooms is proposed
results.observation: An examination for 150 with spacing found no single room and proposed a split across two rooms instead of an empty list.

results.title: No room can seat the request
results.expected: An explanation, not an empty table
results.observation: A request no room can seat returned an explanation, not a blank table.

results.title: Faculty reservation list and statuses
results.expected: Live, pending and cancelled rows with chips
results.observation: The faculty list shows live, pending and cancelled reservations with status chips.

results.title: Cancel with and without a reason
results.expected: Refused without a reason; cancelled and kept with one
results.observation: A cancellation with no reason was refused with REASON_REQUIRED; with a reason the reservation moved to CANCELLED and stayed on record.

results.title: Reschedule a reservation
results.expected: The interval moves
results.observation: The reservation was moved through the reschedule tab; the outcome was 'Moved, still waiting'.

results.title: Finish a class early
results.expected: The remainder returns to the pool
results.observation: The early-release control shortened the interval and returned the remainder to the pool.

results.title: Weekly series created as one action
results.expected: One series, three bookings
results.observation: A weekly series was created as one action and listed with its live booking count.

results.title: Publish a notice to a section
results.expected: Outbox rows written and reported
results.observation: A section notice was published and the number of queued notifications was reported.

results.title: Student schedule with the next class
results.expected: The week's entries plus a next-class callout
results.observation: The student schedule shows the week's entries and the next class with room and time.

results.title: Student files a structured report
results.expected: Report accepted or merged
results.observation: A structured report was accepted, or merged into the open one for that reservation.

results.title: Duplicate report merges
steps: Send the same report a second time
results.expected: Merged into the open item with a count
results.observation: An identical second report merged into the open item and raised its count.

results.title: Student is read-only on availability
results.expected: No reservation form exists
results.observation: A student sees availability and the read-only notice, and no reservation form exists.

results.title: Student navigation has no administrative screens
results.expected: No approval, policy, audit or register screens
results.observation: Student navigation carries no administrative screens.

results.title: Dashboard arithmetic from live data
results.expected: Utilisation, clash risk and examination placement
results.observation: The dashboard reports utilisation, clash risk and examination placement from live data.

results.title: Gated request approved end to end
results.expected: PENDING then CONFIRMED
results.observation: The seminar hall was requested through the faculty form, held as PENDING_APPROVAL, then approved and confirmed by the administrator.

results.title: Rejection demands a reason
results.expected: REASON_REQUIRED, nothing changes
results.observation: A rejection with no reason was refused by the service layer.

results.title: Room register as the reference of record
results.expected: All rooms with bookable and unconfirmed flags
results.requirement: Section 6.4 · reference data is a file
results.observation: The register lists all 34 recorded rooms with bookable and unconfirmed flags.

results.title: Confirm an inferred room fact
results.expected: Flag cleared, change audited
results.observation: An inferred room fact was confirmed in one click and the flag cleared.

results.title: Correct a room capacity
results.expected: Saved with an audit row
results.observation: A capacity correction was saved; the change writes an audit row with before and after.

results.title: Closure against existing reservations
results.expected: Refused, or accepted after showing the affected list
results.observation: The closure was either refused because reservations sit inside it, or accepted because none do; either way the affected list is shown first.

results.title: Resolve a report and notify reporters
results.expected: Resolved and reporters notified
results.observation: The open report was resolved and the reporters were notified.

results.title: Policy change writes history
results.expected: History row recorded
results.observation: A policy value was changed and the change history recorded the previous value.

results.title: Audit trail and room replay
results.expected: State reconstructed from events
results.observation: The audit screen listed events and replayed a room's state at a chosen instant.

results.title: Twenty concurrent requests, one winner
results.expected: One created, the rest refused with alternatives
results.observation: Twenty threads requested one room and one window: one reservation was created and the rest were refused, each carrying alternatives.

results.title: Campus-wide announcement
results.expected: Outbox rows written
results.observation: A campus-wide notice was published with its outbox row count reported.

results.title: Grounded assistant on availability
results.expected: Answer, intent and guardrail status
results.observation: The assistant parsed the question, ran a real query and reported its guardrail status.

results.title: Assistant answers a section question
steps: Ask when CSE-3A's next class is
results.expected: Next class with room and time
results.observation: A section-schedule question was answered from the schedule tables.

results.title: Reset demonstration data
results.expected: The register returns to its seeded state
results.requirement: Definition of done · a reviewer can reset the demo
results.observation: The demonstration data reset returned the register to its seeded state.

results.title: Sign out drops the session
results.expected: Back to the sign-in screen
results.requirement: Policy layer · no session, no shell
results.observation: Signing out returned to the sign-in screen and dropped the shell.
